extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Headless LSP bridge MCP server: pinned language-server sessions as bounded read tools. Theodolite owns its own pinned server sessions for editor-free contexts (workers, gates, sandbox agents) and never touches an editor; diagnostics carry per-diagnostic channel provenance. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Theodolite does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Theodolite

skills.description: Session status and restart for the pinned language-server sessions, and diagnostics (push accumulation merged with pull where the server advertises it) with channel provenance (session_status, session_restart, diagnostics).
skills.name: Diagnostics and sessions

skills.description: Hover, definition, declaration, type definition, implementation, and references from the pinned server session (hover, definition, declaration, type_definition, implementation, references).
skills.name: Code navigation

skills.description: Document and workspace symbol outlines, code-action listings (payloads never returned, never executed), and rename previews (document_symbols, workspace_symbols, code_actions, rename_preview).
skills.name: Symbols and previews
